source_evidence.quote: Thirty-seven women with CC-resistant PCOS were randomly assigned to be pretreated with 500 mg of metformin or placebo 3 times per day for 2 cycles, and 100 mg of CC was given on days 5 through 9 of the second cycle in both groups.

findings.claim: The exclusion for no eligible comparator contradicts the abstract: metformin versus placebo was randomized with the same clomiphene regimen in both groups.

source_evidence.quote: We randomly assigned 626 infertile women with the polycystic ovary syndrome to receive clomiphene citrate plus placebo, extended-release metformin plus placebo, or a combination of metformin and clomiphene for up to 6 months.

findings.claim: The stated absence of an eligible comparator is false. The combination and clomiphene-plus-placebo arms provide the eligible metformin add-on contrast.

source_evidence.quote: The ovulation rate in the metformin group was 64% compared with 72% in the placebo group

findings.claim: This passage mistakes the treatment percentage for an event count: 64/111 is approximately 57.7%. The reported 64% with denominator 111 supports 71/111, as correctly used elsewhere on the page.

source_evidence.quote: A significantly larger proportion of women in the metformin group discontinued treatment because of side effects (16% v 5%; 11%, 5% to 16%).

findings.claim: The reason-code audit incorrectly says the discontinuation value is absent. The source reports arm percentages and a difference with confidence limits; incompatibility with a ratio estimand is distinct from absence of a numerical result.

numeric_checks.outcome: Ovulation with metformin added to clomifene
numeric_checks.note: The supplied per-trial effect and CI fields are null, so direct CI-based recomputation is unavailable. Reconstructed ORs from the supplied counts are 2.7777778, 0.6926829 and 8.25, with log variances 0.5333333333, 0.0825296290 and 0.7853535354. Using their implied Wald intervals gives Paule–Mandel tau² approximately 1.15872145, residual Q=2, HKSJ variance factor 1 and t(2)=4.30265273. The count-based reconstruction agrees with the served pool.
